description: Airbed supervisor lock 2026-10-29 05:42 UTC. Ghost first called 'the supervisor lock' the root cause; the tooling replay then blamed a panel Modbus dropout. Actual root cause (confirmed by Spark): commit 731e0e8 moved desorb_tube_extraction_gas_out_valve from panel riser 5 OD7 to OD6; fixed by 9256f09 (back to OD7).

messages.text: @Ghost airbed locked early this morning and the bag valve stopped switching. Why did it lock?

ground_truth: Root cause: bad code update 731e0e8 (Spark, Oct 28, on ix/refactor-automation / sg/add-valves, live after the controller restarts ending 21:03 UTC) swapped desorb_tube_extraction_gas_out_valve from OD7 to OD6 on panel_station riser 5 — the riser that also carries vent_or_bag_valve. At 05:42:20 UTC riser-5 fields (incl. vent_or_bag_valve) went null, extraction_bag_watchdog tripped on the missing input at 05:42:22 and its recovery failed with Modbus MemoryParityError. Swapping the pin back (9256f09, restart 13:40 UTC) resolved it. The Modbus errors are a symptom, not the root cause.
